description: Source code implementing MD5 message-digest algorithm, including functions for MD5 initialization, update, padding, finalization, and cryptographic hashing (md5_crypt).

methods.name: __md5_Init
methods.description: Initializes MD5 context with standard constants.

methods.name: __md5_Update
methods.description: Updates MD5 context with input data, processing in 64-byte blocks.

methods.name: __md5_Pad
methods.description: Pads the MD5 message to align to 56 bytes and appends length.

methods.name: __md5_Transform
methods.description: Performs MD5 transformation on a 64-byte block.

methods.name: md5_crypt
methods.description: Generates MD5-based password hash with salt, used for password hashing.
